title: AeroCreate
description:
This is an optimized create + aeronautics modpack.
Key mods:
1. Create + addons
2. Create Simulated + Addons
3. Farmer's delight
4. World Host
5. Biomes'o Plenty
6. Support mods and Optimization mods
body:
This is the Modpack I use im My videos on JustFirstVan.
Create Aero is a cool Create modpack that changes Minecraft into a fun steampunk world where you can build and fly all sorts of machines. It is based on the Create mod and all the extra things you can add to it. This means you can build things like hot air balloons and planes with propellers, as well as big airships that stay steady powerful thrusters and big cannons that can do a lot of damage. Create Aero has a lot of Create addons like Aeroworks, Aeronautics Create Propulsion and Create New Age. These addons let you build things with propellers, gyros, electricity and real physics so you can make things that really fly.

The game is more fun because it has Biomes O' Plenty, which makes the landscapes look amazing. You can also cook food with Farmers Delight. Use Create Deco and Copycats+ to build really cool things. The game runs well because it has Sodium, Iris and other things that make it work smoothly even when you are building complicated things that move around.

Whether you are just starting out and building your flying machine or you are a really ambitious engineer who wants to build a whole fleet of planes Create Aero is a great choice. It is a lot of fun and really good for people who like steampunk, flying and building machines. Create Aero is about Create. It is really good, at making the Create experience fun and easy to use. Create Aero has Create addons that make it easy to build and fly Create machines.
